description: This Java class 'JsonToBson' provides functionality to convert JSON values into BSON format, supporting various data types like null, boolean, string, number, array, and object. It implements the 'JsonInternalVisitor' interface for the conversion process and serves as a utility for JSON/BSON transformations within the project.

classes.name: JsonToBson
classes.description: A utility class implementing JSON to BSON conversion, providing static and instance methods to transform various JSON data types into their BSON counterparts.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Static method that initiates the conversion of a JsonValue to a BsonValue by creating an instance and invoking the eval method.

methods.name: bool
methods.description: Converts a boolean Java primitive to its BSON representation.

methods.name: string
methods.description: Converts a String into a BSON String.

methods.name: number
methods.description: Converts a JsonNumber to an appropriate BSON numeric type (int, long, or double).

methods.name: array
methods.description: Converts a Stream of BsonValues into a BSON Array.

methods.name: object
methods.description: Converts a Stream of Map.Entry<String, BsonValue>> into a BSON Document, escaping keys as needed.
